**Reference comparison:**
- **Bacterial_Wilt** references: all lab diagnostic (ooze test in beaker) — no field plant views
- **Verticillium_Wilt**: shows partial wilt with V-shaped leaf lesions — not the complete whole-plant collapse seen in test
- **Southern_Bacterial_Wilt**: stem/root close-up (ID 5473711, adjacent to test) and ooze test — consistent with rapid complete wilt
- **Bacterial_Canker_And_Wilt**: stem cross-section with internal rot — background shows similar dead leaves

The whole-plant rapid wilt with healthy neighbors, combined with the consecutive Bugwood image IDs linking the test image to the Southern_Bacterial_Wilt disease documentation, strongly supports this classification.
